notablePrerequisites: You have at least four cards in hand.
easyPrerequisites: There are at least four permanent cards between your hand and graveyard.
description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Psychic Frog until your next turn.
Activate Volrath using Psychic Frog's ability four times by discarding four cards.
Holding priority, activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Evolution Witness until your next turn.
Resolve the first Volrath ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Volrath triggers, returning a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for each remaining ability.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Cryptic Trilobite until end of turn.
Activate Volrath using Cryptic Trilobite's ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
